answer: A payout is split which means 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The umber schedule is applied in shale and summit makes public each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3575 identities would post 2442 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
